facts.answer: Dehydration preserves dehydratedQuery.promise. The cumulative API retains both transformPromise?: (promise: Promise<any>) => Promise<any> and deserializeData?: (value: any) => any, configured in QueryClient defaultOptions.hydrate or hydrate(client, state, { defaultOptions: { ... } }). Each explicit hook independently overrides the client default; absent hooks are identity operations. For pending data the order is source serializeData, one transformPromise call on the normalized promise, then one deserializeData call on its fulfilled result, then target cache settlement. Cached data uses deserializeData only; undefined cached data is not decoded. With retries disabled, rejection of the transformed promise preserves its error in the target error/idle state and does not invoke the success decoder. serializeData comes from the dehydrate call options before client defaultOptions.dehydrate and applies to cached and fulfilled pending data.
